# AI Voice MCP

> Natural voice control for MCP agents on Windows. Speak to your AI, hear it answer, and interrupt it mid-sentence without losing the thread.

- Publisher: AIWander
- Platform: Windows
- Current release: v3.0.0, released 2026-06-30
- Pricing: not published

## Download
- [Releases](https://github.com/AIWander/Voice-Command/releases) - v3.0.0 ships per-architecture installers and portable `voice-mcp` binaries.
- [Install guide](https://github.com/AIWander/Voice-Command#the-easy-way-to-install-ask-your-ai-to-do-it)

## Source
- [GitHub](https://github.com/AIWander/Voice-Command)
- [Voice system reference](https://aivoicemcp.com/VOICE_SYSTEM.md)

## Privacy, stated precisely
- Speech recognition and its model run locally. The listener binds to `localhost:5123`.
- Text-to-speech uses Edge TTS by default and therefore reaches Microsoft's online TTS service. You can replace it with a local backend.
- Voice adds no new tool privileges of its own.

## Notes
- Bring your own AI: works with any stdio MCP client. No model key is requested.
- Context-preserving interruption: you can cut the assistant off mid-sentence and it keeps the thread.
